# Prof. Aleks Farseev

> Aleks Farseev (Aleksandr Farseev, 法信夫) is the Founder & CEO of SOMIN.ai, a Guest Professor in AI at NUS and INSEAD, an award-winning AI researcher (h-index 23 on Google Scholar, 30+ peer-reviewed papers), an international keynote speaker, and a professional accordionist. He is based in Singapore, with a presence in London and Hong Kong.

Aleks earned his Ph.D. in Computer Science from the National University of Singapore, where his research pioneered multi-view user profiling — synthesising fragmented social-network signals into predictive models of human behaviour. He now leads SOMIN.ai, a generative-AI platform for marketers, and researches explainable generative AI (tackling LLM hallucination and opacity). He is a Marketing & Advertising Community Leader and columnist at the Forbes Technology Council, and the founder of the Accordion Singapore community.

## Key facts
- Full name: Aleksandr "Aleks" Farseev (Chinese name: 法信夫)
- Role: Founder & CEO of SOMIN.ai
- Academia: Guest Professor at NUS and INSEAD; Research Professor at ITMO University; Faculty at Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS)
- Research areas: multi-view user profiling, multimodal sensor fusion, cross-network recommendation, generative-AI explainability
- Scholarship: h-index 23 (Google Scholar); 30+ peer-reviewed publications (ACM Multimedia, WWW, SIGIR, WSDM, AAAI); named inventor on a filed US patent for automated insight generation using LLMs
- Awards: Gartner Cool Vendor — AI for Marketing (2020); Echelon Top 10 Startups (e27, 2025); SBR National Business Award (2022); Web Science Trust Person of the Year
- Music: professional accordionist; founder of Accordion Singapore; violin-and-accordion duo (A&A Music Academy) with Prof. Alexander Souptel; 500+ performances since 1990
- Faith: APAC / Southeast Asia Ambassador for the Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement; SOMIN.ai is part of DMV Redemptive Labs
- Languages: English, Russian, Chinese
- Location: Singapore · London · Hong Kong
- Contact: a@somin.ai · +65 9122 7009

## Ventures
- [SOMIN.ai](https://somin.ai/): generative-AI marketing platform. Capabilities span audience targeting, competitor analytics, generative content and influencer discovery, with predictions anchored in industry-verified data on Meta and Google. Certified Google ISV; Meta Llama Incubator (APAC).

## Music
- [Accordion Singapore / A&A Music Academy](https://accordion.sg/): Singapore's premier violin-and-accordion duo and music school; performances, weddings and lessons.

## Faith
- Aleks is the APAC / Southeast Asia Ambassador for the Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement and the founder of its Singapore chapter (Faith Driven Singapore), now 200+ members. The chapter began with an invitation from FDE co-founder Henry Kaestner to "start one here"; it has since spread to Taipei, with London (Meta's office) and Kenya launching next. Co-builders include Aidan Chan and Yuh Tyng Hsiao.
- [Faith Driven Singapore](https://faithdriven.sg/): Christ-following entrepreneur community (Aleks is APAC/SEA Ambassador)
- [Salt&Light feature](https://saltandlight.sg/business/how-a-child-like-prayer-for-ducks-laid-the-faith-foundation-for-an-ai-start-up/): Aleks's story of faith and entrepreneurship
- [Orthodox Singapore](https://orthodox.sg/): Aleks is part of Singapore's Orthodox Christian community
